events.verdict: Grimes (PHI) is bracing for the contact from Santos (GSW) and marginal contact occurs as he releases away as they come together during the drive.
Santos (GSW) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Grimes' (PHI) driving shot attempt.
George (PHI) applies his left hand to Moody's (GSW) body as he jumps alongside his path, and the contact during Moody's shot near the rim is marginal.
George (PHI) re-establishes himself in bounds prior to him making contact with the ball.
George (PHI) is moving alongside Moody's (GSW) path as they come together during the drive, and the contact is marginal.
Grimes (PHI) steps forward into Santos' (GSW) path and initiates leg to leg contact with Santos as he is elevating for his shot near the rim.

Replay review of the foul called on Green (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Green jumps forward towards Grimes (PHI) and initiates body to body contact that affects Grimes' ability to land safely after the release of his jump shot.
Possession is awarded to the 76ers.  George (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession should have been awarded to the Warriors.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Oubre Jr. (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Santos (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the 76ers.
Payton II (GSW) is already in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.
Maxey (PHI) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Green (GSW) initiates contact with Maxey's (PHI) arm prior to making contact with the ball, or the part of Maxey's hand that is on the ball, and the contact causes Maxey to lose possession.

There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if Maxey's (PHI) left hand makes contact with the ball while his left foot is touching the sideline.  Therefore, possession is correctly awarded to the Warriors.
Santos' (GSW) left foot is out of bounds when he receives the pass.  Possession is correctly awarded to the 76ers.
Moody (GSW) commits a take foul on George (PHI).
